messages:
Alex: quick FYI — prototyping a “prefetch credit preview” panel for the cost dashboard. shows per-route token shift when prefetches hit, and how routing priority changes net unit cost. sharing so routing/console folks can weigh in.
Priya: nice. is this purely additive (shows credits) or does it simulate actual sticky-routing outcomes?
Alex: it can do both. default is additive preview; toggle to run a simulated re-route that applies sticky routing heuristics and recomputes per-tenant chargeback. demo snippet below.
Sam: can you paste the snippet? would help me reason about telemetry joins.
Alex: sure — quick sim config:
```
{
  "route": "search.query",
  "prefetch_enabled": true,
  "sample_rate": 0.02,
  "credit_split": {"hotpath": 0.65, "prefetch": 0.35},
  "apply_sticky_routing": true
}
```
Jamie: important we surface sampling bias — if sample_rate < 1 the preview can under/over estimate cache savings. add a confidence column plz (:eyes:).
Marta: also needs per-model SKU column. prefetch might shift work to smaller/larger SKUs depending on model variant chosen during routing fallback.
Priya: agree. also call out that quotas may block prefetches — preview should show "blocked by quota" count. otherwise product will be confused when live numbers differ.
Sam: on telemetry side, we should join trace_id -> routing_decision -> cache_hits -> token_consumed. if we include `simulate_rewrite=true` we need extra sampling to not overload prod. recommend using staging dataset + attach a canary tag.
Alex: plan: stage rollout 10% of orgs, preview mode default OFF, per-tenant opt-in. UI: slider for sample_rate and a "what-if routing priority" dropdown. exportable CSV.
Jamie: UX note — show before/after per-tenant latency delta and cost delta side-by-side. That calms finance questions.
Marta: +1. Add per-model token-weighted cost (i.e., token_count * model_unit_cost) so it’s clear when small token delta but big $ impact due to model.
Priya: request: add an API param so infra can call the sim from automation tests: `POST /internal/cost/simulate?org=...&canary=true`. make sure auth + rate limits exist.
Alex: yep. will add endpoint and rate-limit to 5r/s for now.
Sam: deploy-bot, can you spin a preview deploy to staging for us to poke?
deploy-bot: preview panel deployed to `staging` at `https://console.staging.redwood/costs/prefetch-preview` — tests running. :rocket:
Alex: great — I'll attach a short test plan and a few synthetic traces. tagging @Priya and @Sam for telemetry checks.
Priya: I'll run sampling join and push a patch if I see mismatch.
Jamie: once staging looks good can we do a 1-week canary with billing-syncs off? product wants to avoid surprise invoices.
Marta: +1 — also gate by model-sku list: only enable for models in the curated catalog until we trust quantization heuristics.
Alex: noted. thanks all — will follow up w/ PR + mockups. :thumbsup:
